# Quickstart — Stream Consumption Contract

**Generated by**: `/speckit.plan`
**Date**: 2026-05-31
**Audience**: developer landing this spec, ops reviewing the deployment, consumer team validating the contract.

## What this feature delivers

A single authenticated endpoint that answers one question for the downstream consumer:

> "Can I trust the 13 onchain streams enough to start a strict-mode run?"

If the answer is `overall == "OK"`, the consumer proceeds. Otherwise the consumer either blocks or downgrades to research-only — silently consuming stale data is no longer possible.

Plus a systemd timer that keeps three of those streams from going stale in the first place.

## Run the contract locally

### 1. Start the API

```bash
cd /media/sam/1TB/UTXOracle
setsid uv run uvicorn api.main:app --port 8001 >> /tmp/api.log 2>&1 &
```

### 2. Mint a bearer token

```bash
# Use whatever your existing dev workflow produces. The endpoint reuses
# api/auth_middleware.py:HTTPBearer — same token shape as the rest of /v1/*.
export UTXO_TOKEN="<your dev token>"
```

### 3. Poll the endpoint

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $UTXO_TOKEN" \
  http://localhost:8001/v1/streams/health | jq .
```

Expected response shape (truncated):

```json
{
  "as_of": "2026-05-31T12:00:00Z",
  "streams": [
    {"name": "live_snapshots", "last_row_ts": "2026-05-31T11:59:30Z",
     "stale_seconds": 30, "sla_seconds": 3600, "schema_version": "1.0.0",
     "status": "OK"},
    "... (12 more) ..."
  ],
  "overall": "OK"
}
```

### 4. Verify the rollup gate

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $UTXO_TOKEN" \
  http://localhost:8001/v1/streams/health | jq -r .overall
# expected: OK
```

If you see `DEGRADED`, inspect which streams are off:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $UTXO_TOKEN" \
  http://localhost:8001/v1/streams/health \
  | jq '.streams[] | select(.status != "OK") | {name, status, stale_seconds, sla_seconds}'
```

## Install the daily aggregator timer

```bash
sudo cp utxoracle-daily-aggregator.service /etc/systemd/system/
sudo cp utxoracle-daily-aggregator.timer /etc/systemd/system/
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now utxoracle-daily-aggregator.timer

# Verify
systemctl list-timers | grep utxoracle-daily-aggregator
systemctl status utxoracle-daily-aggregator.timer
```

Watch the first scheduled run:

```bash
journalctl -u utxoracle-daily-aggregator.service -f
```

## Catch up `utxo_lifecycle` (one-off operational task)

```bash
# Runs in background; tail the log to monitor.
setsid uv run python -m scripts.bootstrap.historical_spent_backfill \
  --resume --target-backend questdb \
  >> /tmp/backfill_utxo_lifecycle.log 2>&1 &

tail -f /tmp/backfill_utxo_lifecycle.log
```

When complete, the `utxo_lifecycle_full` stream in `/v1/streams/health` should report `status: OK`.

## Run the acceptance test (the CI gate)

```bash
# Unit (fast, fully mocked)
uv run pytest tests/test_streams_health.py -v

# Integration (requires live QuestDB on :8812)
uv run pytest tests/integration/test_streams_health_contract.py -v -m integration
```

The integration test asserts `overall == "OK"` against the live registry. **This is the gate for closing Issue #8.**

## Edit the contract (the right way to change a stream)

```bash
# 1. Edit docs/contracts/stream_registry.yaml in a PR.
# 2. For a breaking change:
#    - Set `deprecated_at: "YYYY-MM-DD"` on the old entry.
#    - Add a new entry with bumped `schema_version`.
#    - The old entry MUST stay in the registry for 30 days minimum.
# 3. For an additive change (new column): bump nothing; PR the schema in `pinned_columns`.
# 4. The endpoint reloads only at FastAPI restart — restart the service after the PR merges.
```
